A true flagship in every sense of the word, this 2012 Mercedes-Benz CL65 AMG showcases the height of Mercedes-Benz engineering, luxury, and performance from an era when AMG was building some of the most outrageous road cars in the world. Combining timeless pillarless coupe styling with a handcrafted twin-turbocharged V12 and an original MSRP exceeding $211,000, the CL65 AMG remains one of the most exclusive and powerful grand touring coupes ever produced. Designed for those who demand effortless speed, exceptional comfort, and understated presence, the CL65 delivers a driving experience that is every bit as special today as it was when new.

At the heart of the CL65 AMG lies a hand-built 6.0-liter twin-turbocharged V12 producing an astonishing 621 horsepower and 738 lb-ft of torque. Paired with AMG's SpeedShift automatic transmission, this immense powerplant delivers effortless acceleration and endless torque at any speed, making the CL65 one of the most formidable luxury coupes ever built. The signature AMG sport exhaust system provides a refined yet authoritative soundtrack, while AMG-tuned suspension, massive AMG brakes, and performance-focused chassis enhancements ensure confidence-inspiring handling despite its grand touring nature.

The cabin showcases the craftsmanship expected of a six-figure flagship Mercedes-Benz, featuring Black Exclusive Leather upholstery, heated and ventilated multi-contour AMG sport seats with massage functionality, dynamic bolsters, memory settings, and lumbar support. Land Rover Riverside is delighted to showcase this Pre-Owned 2021 Porsche 911 Carrera. Finished in timeless White over a sophisticated Black interior and showing just 11,468 miles, this iconic sports car perfectly embodies Porsche's legendary blend of exhilarating performance, everyday usability, and unmistakable design.

The 911 Carrera's unmistakable silhouette remains one of the most recognizable in automotive history. Its crisp White exterior accentuates the car's sculpted body lines, athletic stance, and rear-engine proportions. LED lighting, signature wide rear haunches, and Porsche's meticulous attention to aerodynamic detail ensure this Carrera delivers an appearance that is both elegant and purposeful.

Inside, the Black interior surrounds occupants with premium craftsmanship and modern technology. The driver-focused cockpit features high-quality materials, intuitive controls, supportive sport seating, and Porsche's advanced infotainment system. Every surface has been thoughtfully designed to create a cabin that is equally luxurious for daily driving and rewarding during spirited drives.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this 911 Carrera is a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged flat-six engine, producing 379 horsepower and 331 lb-ft of torque. Paired with Porsche's lightning-fast 8-speed PDK dual-clutch transmission, this legendary powertrain delivers immediate throttle response, seamless gear changes, and exceptional balance, allowing the Carrera to sprint from 0-60 mph in approximately 4.0 seconds while maintaining the precision and confidence Porsche is renowned for.

Key Features:

• 3.0-Liter Twin-Turbo Flat-Six Engine: Delivers exhilarating acceleration with the unmistakable character of Porsche's iconic rear-engine sports car.

• 8-Speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK): Provides lightning-fast shifts and exceptional driving refinement.

• LED Headlights: Brilliant illumination paired with the unmistakable Porsche lighting signature.

• Porsche Communication Management (PCM): Intuitive infotainment system featuring navigation, smartphone integration, and advanced connectivity.

• Sport Seats: Designed to provide outstanding comfort during daily driving while offering excellent support during spirited performance driving.

• Rear-Engine Performance: The legendary 911 layout delivers remarkable balance, traction, and an engaging driving experience unlike any other sports car.

This 2021 Porsche 911 Carrera is far more than just a luxury sports car, it is the culmination of decades of engineering excellence, timeless design, and world-class performance. Available at Land Rover Riverside, this low-mileage example offers an exceptional opportunity to own one of the most celebrated sports cars ever built.

Allow us to also help arrange transportation of your new car directly to your home anywhere in the world. Trade-in proposals are always welcome. If you like this vehicle and have questions, simply call, email, or drop by our location at 8051 Auto Dr, Riverside, CA 92504. We invite you to Activate Your Ownership with us today!

- 5.5L V12
- 6 Speed Manual Transmission
- Only 20,551 Miles
- Green Exterior
- Tan Interior
- Original Window Sticker and Owners Manuals

The Ferrari 456 GT is one of Maranello's finest grand touring cars, combining breathtaking V12 performance with elegant Pininfarina styling and genuine long-distance comfort. Even more desirable is a factory 6-speed manual transmission, making examples like this increasingly sought after by collectors. Showing just 20,551 original miles and finished in a stunning Green exterior over a Tan leather interior, this 1995 Ferrari 456 GT is a beautifully preserved example of one of Ferrari's most underrated modern classics. Accompanied by its original window sticker and owners manuals, it represents an outstanding opportunity to own a low-mileage, highly original Ferrari.

Power comes from Ferrari's magnificent 5.5-liter naturally aspirated V12, producing nearly 440 horsepower and delivering the unmistakable soundtrack that only a Ferrari twelve-cylinder can provide. Mated to the coveted gated 6-speed manual transmission, the 456 GT offers an engaging driving experience that has become increasingly rare in the modern supercar world. Capable of effortless high-speed touring while remaining refined and comfortable, the 456 GT was designed to cross continents with ease while still delivering the exhilarating performance expected from the Prancing Horse.

Penned by the legendary design house Pininfarina, the 456 GT features timeless proportions with a long sculpted hood, flowing roofline, and subtle aerodynamic styling that has aged gracefully over the past three decades. The rare Green finish complements the car's elegant design beautifully, while the luxurious Tan leather interior surrounds occupants with handcrafted materials, rich wood trim, and the level of comfort expected from Ferrari's flagship grand tourer. Unlike many exotic cars of its era, the 456 GT offers usable rear seating, making it one of the few Ferraris capable of accommodating four passengers.

As enthusiasts continue to recognize the significance of analog Ferraris equipped with manual transmissions, the 456 GT has become one of the marque's best-kept secrets. Low-mileage, well-documented examples with factory 6-speed manuals are becoming increasingly difficult to find, making this 1995 Ferrari 456 GT an exceptional opportunity for collectors and driving enthusiasts alike. Whether destined for a curated collection or enjoyed on spirited weekend drives, this Ferrari delivers timeless style, world-class engineering, and one of the greatest V12 driving experiences ever produced.

Convenience
  • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
Technology and Telematics
  • SYNC 4 AppLink/Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

2015 BMW M4 Coupe | 6-Speed Manual | Only 7,741 Miles
Three Pedals. Three Pedals. That's All You Need to Know.

Some cars are built for everyone. This one was built for the enthusiast.

Finished in Black Sapphire Metallic over a Black leather interior, this 2015 BMW M4 Coupe is the kind of car collectors and driving purists spend years searching for. With an incredible 7,741 original miles and equipped with the highly sought-after 6-speed manual transmission, this is more than just a performance coupeit's one of the finest examples of the F82 generation you'll likely come across.

BMW's M engineers created the M4 to reward the driver, and the manual transmission is exactly how many enthusiasts believe it should be experienced. Every shift, every corner, and every throttle input reminds you why the M division has earned its legendary reputation. As the automotive world continues moving toward automatics and electrification, low-mileage manual M cars like this are becoming increasingly collectible.

Under the hood is BMW's 425-horsepower twin-turbocharged inline-six, delivering explosive performance while maintaining the refinement expected from a world-class grand touring coupe. Whether you're carving through Carmel Valley, cruising Highway 1, or simply heading out for an early morning drive, this M4 transforms every trip into an occasion.

Before being offered for sale, our team completed a comprehensive inspection and invested in preparing this exceptional BMW for its next owner. At approximately 7,700 miles, the following services were completed:

Four brand-new tires installed and road-force balanced
Comprehensive maintenance and safety inspections performed
Brake system inspected
All vehicle fluids checked
Tire pressure and overall tire condition verified
Keyless entry remotes serviced with new batteries, including replacement remotes where needed

It's rare to find a performance car with this level of mileage that's also received this kind of attention before delivery. Simply put, this M4 is ready to be enjoyed.

The Victory Automotive Promise

Every pre-owned vehicle at Land Rover Monterey is thoroughly inspected by our factory-trained technicians and includes two keys whenever available, along with our Monterey Vehicle Protection Package, featuring clear-film protection for the door edges and door cups, plus professionally applied interior and exterior protective sealants. Optional warranty coverage is available on these protection products, helping preserve your investment and keep your vehicle looking exceptional for years to come.

Finding an F82 M4 is easy. Finding a 6-speed manual with under 8,000 miles, fresh tires, recent service, and this level of preservation is something else entirely. Opportunities like this don't come around often, and once they're gone, they're incredibly difficult to replace.

Questions? Want a personalized walkaround video?

Text our General Sales Manager, Titus Baila, directly at 623-398-4130 or our General Manager, Joey Goulart, at 408-687-3510. We're here to answer your questions, provide additional photos or videos, and help make your purchase as easy as possiblewherever you're located.

description: EXHILARATING, LOW MILEAGE, NONSMOKER, A TRUE DRIVER'S PORSCHE! The 2016 Porsche Cayman GTS represents everything enthusiasts love about Porsche's mid-engine sports cars. Perfectly balanced, beautifully engineered, and powered by one of the finest naturally aspirated flat-six engines of its era, the Cayman GTS delivers an experience that's equally rewarding on a winding mountain road, a weekend escape, or an afternoon at the racetrack. Every control input feels precise, every corner feels connected, and every drive reminds you why Porsche remains one of the world's most respected performance manufacturers. Unlike many rear-engine or front-engine sports cars, the Cayman's mid-engine layout places the engine directly behind the seats, creating exceptional balance and remarkably neutral handling. Combined with Porsche's legendary chassis engineering, it delivers confidence-inspiring agility that's often considered among the very best in the sports car world. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Cayman GTS occupies a special place within Porsche's lineup because it perfectly bridges the gap between the Cayman S and the track-focused GT4. Buyers appreciate its naturally aspirated engine, everyday usability, premium craftsmanship, and extraordinary handling precision while enjoying a car that's equally comfortable on the street or at a driver's education event. Many Porsche enthusiasts consider the naturally aspirated 981-generation Cayman GTS to be one of the finest driver's cars Porsche has ever built. Its immediate throttle response, exhilarating soundtrack, hydraulic-like steering feel, and superb chassis balance have earned it an enduring reputation as a modern classic. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The Cayman GTS has received universal praise from automotive journalists around the world. Reviewers consistently highlight its beautifully balanced chassis, communicative steering, naturally aspirated flat-six engine, and astonishing precision, with many describing it as one of the greatest sports cars ever produced regardless of price. Car and Driver 10Best Automobile Magazine All-Star Frequently recognized as one of the greatest driver's cars of the modern era Widely regarded as one of Porsche's finest naturally aspirated sports cars Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 25,617-mile mark. Although the factory warranty has expired, this exceptionally low-mileage Cayman GTS has been driven sparingly over the years and continues to represent an outstanding opportunity for enthusiasts seeking one of Porsche's most celebrated modern sports cars.     • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
    • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. description: 1983 was the final year of production for the Datsun 280ZX, and it was also the last year the Datsun nameplate appeared on this car at all. Starting with the 300ZX that replaced it in 1984, the Z-car wore only the Nissan badge going forward. That makes the 1983 280ZX the end of an era in the most literal sense, the final expression of the Z-car under the name that started it all. This one is finished in Thunder Black, spec'd as a GL 2+2 with the five speed manual, the leather and digital package, and the T-bar roof with tinted removable glass panels. The T-bar was only available in combination with the GL package, so the presence of one confirms the other. The original window sticker shows an MSRP of $17,774, a significant number for a Japanese sports car in 1983, and it comes with the car today. Under the hood is the 2.8 liter inline six backed by a five speed manual transmission. The 280ZX was Motor Trend's Import Car of the Year when it debuted in 1979 and set a record for Z-car sales in its first year on the market. Nissan deliberately moved the Z-car upmarket with this generation, adding four-wheel independent suspension, rack and pinion steering, and a level of refinement that Car and Driver called a genuine grand tourer. The GL package includes power windows, power door locks, air conditioning, and alloy wheels as standard, rounding out a car that was positioned directly against the Celica Supra and the Porsche 944 in the import performance market. Inside, the tan leather interior is clean and well appointed with the door card stitching from the 280ZX carrying through the cabin. The digital instrument cluster with audio voice alerts was one of the most technologically advanced features available in any production car in 1983, the kind of detail that made buyers feel like they were sitting in something from the future. It still feels distinctive today. The 280ZX's place in the Z-car lineage has been quietly reassessed by collectors over the last several years. The first-generation 240Z through 280Z cars have always commanded strong money, and as those prices have moved out of reach for many buyers, the 280ZX has stepped forward as the accessible alternative with genuine pedigree and a well-documented history of reliability. A Thunder Black GL 2+2 with the five speed, the T-bar, the digital package, and the original window sticker from the final year of production is exactly what that reassessment looks like in practice. 2004 Ford Mustang Mach 1 For Sale
This 2004 Ford Mustang Mach 1 is a factory-original example from the final year of Ford's SN-95-generation retro tribute, sold new by Liberty Ford Southwest and carrying just 13,900 miles across two owners. Finished in Azure Blue Clearcoat over a Dark Charcoal leather interior, the car retains its original Ford window sticker, which documents its build as order code 145A, Premium Mach 1 V8.

Power comes from the 4.6L 4-valve DOHC V8, the Mach 1's signature engine derived from the aluminum-block Cobra powerplant of the late 1990s rather than the cast-iron block used in the contemporary 2003-04 SVT Cobra. Ford rated the combination at 305 horsepower and 320 lb-ft of torque, run through a 5-speed manual transmission to a 3.55-geared Traction-Lok rear axle. The functional "shaker" hood scoop feeds the engine directly through the hood, a detail carried over from the original 1969-1970 Mach 1 and one of the clearest links between this car and the model it pays tribute to. Dual exhaust with bright tips rounds out the drivetrain.

Chassis hardware includes power four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and traction control, variable-rate rear suspension, and power rack-and-pinion steering, riding on 17-inch Heritage alloy wheels wrapped in P245/45ZR17 tires. Inside, the Dark Charcoal leather sport seats use the Mach 1's "comfort weave" trim pattern, paired with a nostalgic-style instrument cluster, leather-wrapped tilt steering wheel, speed control, and a Mach-branded 6-disc CD stereo. Power windows and locks, dual vanity mirrors, remote keyless entry, and SecuriLock round out the equipment list.

2004 marked both the last year of the SN-95 Mustang platform before the 2005 redesign and the Mustang's 40th anniversary, and Ford brought the Mach 1 back for only two model years, 2003 and 2004, as a modern homage to the original. Just 7,182 were built for 2004. With low, consistent two-owner mileage and factory documentation on hand, this car represents a well-preserved example of a short-run tribute model that's become increasingly sought after as SN-95 Mustangs age into classic status.

description: SPORTY, REVIVED, MODERN, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, OFF-LEASE, NONSMOKER, LEGEND REBORN! The 2026 Honda Prelude marks the triumphant return of one of Honda's most beloved nameplates. Combining sleek coupe styling, advanced hybrid performance, modern technology, and Honda's legendary reputation for engineering excellence, the Prelude returns to a market that has been eagerly awaiting its comeback. For enthusiasts, the Prelude name carries decades of history. Previous generations earned acclaim for their balanced handling, innovative technology, and driver-focused character. The all-new Prelude embraces that heritage while incorporating the electrified technology and refinement expected from a modern Honda. Rather than chasing extreme performance figures, the Prelude focuses on delivering an engaging and rewarding driving experience. Its sleek coupe profile, responsive chassis, and sophisticated powertrain create a vehicle designed for drivers who genuinely enjoy being behind the wheel. Automotive journalists praised the Prelude's return, applauding Honda's decision to bring back a legendary nameplate while preserving the spirit that made the original so memorable. Reviewers highlighted its blend of efficiency, technology, and driver engagement. The result is a coupe that successfully bridges Honda's performance heritage with its electrified future. One of the Most Anticipated Vehicle Launches of 2026 Praised for reviving an iconic Honda nameplate Recognized for combining efficiency with driving enjoyment Celebrated for bringing the coupe experience into the electrified era The odometer is hovering around the 4,111-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. The Prelude's advanced hybrid-electric powertrain delivers the smooth, responsive performance Honda is known for while improving efficiency and reducing emissions. Instant electric assistance enhances low-speed response and everyday drivability, helping create a more refined and engaging driving experience. Honda engineered the Prelude to deliver the balanced handling and driver confidence that enthusiasts expect from the badge. Precise steering, sophisticated suspension tuning, and a low-slung coupe design help create a connection between driver and machine that has become increasingly rare in today's marketplace. The hybrid system seamlessly blends electric and gasoline power, providing strong efficiency without sacrificing responsiveness. The Prelude's exterior design is both modern and unmistakably sporty. Sleek proportions, an athletic stance, and flowing body lines create a coupe that looks fast even when standing still. The design pays subtle tribute to earlier Prelude generations while embracing contemporary Honda styling. The result is a vehicle that feels fresh and modern without abandoning its heritage. Its low roofline, sculpted profile, and aggressive front-end treatment help establish a distinctive identity among today's increasingly SUV-dominated landscape. Inside, the cabin reflects Honda's focus on quality, ergonomics, and driver engagement. Premium materials, intuitive controls, and modern technology create an environment that feels sophisticated and welcoming. The coupe layout provides a sporty driving position while maintaining everyday comfort. Thoughtful design and intelligent packaging help maximize usability without compromising style. Technology is integrated throughout the Prelude experience. Advanced connectivity features, modern infotainment systems, digital displays, and intelligent vehicle controls help keep drivers informed, connected, and entertained. Honda's reputation for user-friendly technology ensures that these systems remain intuitive and easy to operate during everyday use. Safety remains a major Honda priority. Advanced driver-assistance technologies, collision-mitigation systems, lane-centering features, adaptive safety technologies, and occupant-protection systems work together to help provide confidence behind the wheel. Whether commuting daily, enjoying a favorite back road, or simply appreciating the return of a legendary nameplate, the Prelude was engineered to make every drive memorable. ... and there's SO MUCH more! The 2026 Honda Prelude Coupe successfully revives one of the most respected names in Honda history.
